name: Reactive Resistance (Su)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Magus 6, Reactive Conduit

Benefit(s): Whenever the magus is exposed to energy damage from a spell or magical effect, she may spend one point from her arcane pool as a swift action to absorb a portion of this energy, gaining energy resistance 5 of the type exposed to for 1 round per point of Intelligence bonus.
